# ATLAS Studio

> ATLAS Studio runs four fixed-price B2B services. Every service publishes its prices, its limits and a complete sample deliverable; a person reviews every deliverable before delivery, and facts, numbers and files are checked by deterministic scripts, not by AI alone.

## Services

- [SignalDesk](https://signaldesk-b2b.vercel.app/signaldesk/en/): Qualified B2B research. For small B2B agencies with a clear offer: a shortlist of companies qualified against your criteria, every reason sourced and dated, and outreach briefs you can stand behind. From 290 USD. French page: https://signaldesk-b2b.vercel.app/signaldesk/
- [Localoom](https://localoom-catalogues.vercel.app/localoom/en/): FR/EN e-commerce catalogues. For e-commerce shops and agencies: consistent French and English product pages tied to your own data, and an import file ready for your platform. From 180 USD. French page: https://localoom-catalogues.vercel.app/localoom/
- [FlowPatch](https://flowpatch-automation.vercel.app/flowpatch/en/): Reliable admin automations. For small teams repeating an admin task: one bounded process between two apps that behaves sensibly when something breaks — and that your owner understands. From 350 USD. French page: https://flowpatch-automation.vercel.app/flowpatch/
- [CareerLift](https://careerlift-cv.vercel.app/careerlift/en/): FR/EN job applications. For one person, one job family and one target posting: French and English CVs, a professional profile and an application, every line traced to your documents or statements. From 340 USD. French page: https://careerlift-cv.vercel.app/careerlift/
